text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her fierce battle in 
Hokkaido, Red Desire fully joined the 
summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With only a little time left in summer 
training camp—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With the Japan Cup ahead of us, we cannot 
afford to waste a single second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, there are still lingering 
concerns about her physical condition. I 
can't push her too hard here..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Your thoughts are as clear to me as if I 
were holding them in my hands.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Could this also be because my Saint Power 
is rising for the "Final Trial"?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Or... could it be because the bond 
between us is growing stronger?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu... There is no need to worry, I 
certainly won't push myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Guided by the bonds of so many people, I 
have walked this path to where I am 
today."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have so many people who believe in me. 
People who entrust their hopes, pour in 
their wishes, and watch over me—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You are... no longer alone. I will not let 
a single person wear a sad expression.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall repay everyoneâ all those who 
have entrusted their hopes to me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because I am the Saint.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A phrase I must have heard countless 
times. Yet... for some reason, it 
resonated deep within my heart with a 
weight unlike anything before.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us head back. I shall ensure I am in 
peak condition for tomorrow's training.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan! You're back.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Just the other day. I have returned 
here and am working hard on my training 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—...? Desire-chan, have you... changed a 
bit?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe it's because I overcame a great 
trial.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see... Yeah, you're right. You know, we 
all watched the broadcast of Desire-chan's 
Sapporo Kinen together.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan's running was truly 
incredible... I was totally overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it... it feels like 
everything is completely razor-sharp...!”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...She was crying, this little lady.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: N-Nakayama-san...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, Saintess... Looks like the vibe 
around you's changed quite a bit."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I thought you were absurd enough during 
the Sapporo Kinen... but to be like that 
on a daily basis? Color me impressed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one wearing a fearless grin is 
Nakayama Festa. She's a gambler Umamusume 
who loves reveling in the thrill.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Did you watch it too, 
Nakayama-san?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you little ladies insisted on it, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We didn't plan it beforehand, but we 
seemed to have gathered naturally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume smiling with impeccable 
manners is the earnest and meticulous 
Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Desire-san, everyone was simply stunned by 
your valiant performance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Because you had far exceeded our 
expectations... and transformed into an 
overwhelming threat."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone believed in you, Desire-san. 
That you would definitely return to the 
turf."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And that... in the next race, you'll be 
running alongside us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Offering a gentle smile is Victoire Pisa. 
A horse girl draped in angelic purity.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: By next race, could it be...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Naturally—it's the "Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Appearing with movements so graceful they 
captivated all who watched was Rose 
Kingdom. A noble, proud Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Members of the generation one year below 
Red Desire had gathered. They were top 
contenders who fought fiercely in this 
year's Japanese Derby and Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Everyone watched your run and became 
convinced. You overcame adversity... and 
became something truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“—Nevertheless. We, too, cannot simply 
accept defeat lying down.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup—a battle where each 
contender puts their stubborn pride on the 
line.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"This will surely be the grandest stage of 
all. Let us fight fair and square."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry to bring that up out of 
nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
When I heard Desire-chan might run in the 
Japan Cup... I just got so excited all on 
my own...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I was trembling with sheer, overwhelming 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even as they worry for me... in the depths 
of their eyes lies a wild light, aiming to 
devour me and seize the crown for 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes are fixed solely on the 
victory they believe in!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is it! The supreme, soul-scorching 
'Ordeal' that I have sought all along!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To think that even after overcoming the 
'Crimson Wedge', such a severe trial still 
awaited me—!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ――...Did I just hear something...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (A shiver...)

text_block_list.name: Flash & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: ――…… ……Ha, interesting.

text_block_list.name: Rose & Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Just as I thought, you are... Ufufu..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. That's... who 
Desire-chan has always been."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's clash as our best selves in the 
Japan Cup, Desire-chan!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course. When I overcome that colossal 
wall that is you all, Iâthis 
vesselâwill surely be fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: At the Japan Cup, I shall attain it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful... for meeting all of 
you, and for this magnificent destiny—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The contenders taking on the Japan Cup. 
The fighting spirit radiating from them 
scorched the late summer air with heat—
